description: Get the latest narrative forecast product from a Weather Forecast Office (WFO). The default product is AFD (Area Forecast Discussion), which explains the meteorological reasoning behind the forecast — synoptic setup, model guidance, and forecaster confidence. Other types: HWO (Hazardous Weather Outlook, 1-7 day severe/flood/winter outlook), ZFP (Zone Forecast Product, zone-by-zone text), SPS (Special Weather Statement, short-fuse advisory). The office code is the 3-letter WFO identifier returned as the "office" field by nws_get_forecast. A product over 24,000 bytes (most ZFPs) comes back as an outline of its sections — AFD section names, or ZFP/HWO/SPS zone segments with their area names — with each section's size, instead of the text; re-call with sections to get the ones you need. sections also works on a product of any size, to read one AFD section or one zone's forecast.

office.description: Product location code of 2–3 letters or digits, case-insensitive — usually the 3-letter Weather Forecast Office (WFO) code (e.g., "SEW" for Seattle, "LOX" for Los Angeles), returned as the "office" field in nws_get_forecast output. Some offices file a product under other codes: Anchorage files its ZFP under "AER" (Anchorage East) and "ALU" (Anchorage West), not "AFC"; San Juan files its ZFP under "PR", and Guam its SPS under "PQ1".

product_type.description: Product type code. AFD (Area Forecast Discussion) — meteorological reasoning, model analysis, forecaster confidence. HWO (Hazardous Weather Outlook) — 1-7 day outlook for severe weather, flooding, winter weather. ZFP (Zone Forecast Product) — detailed zone-by-zone text forecast. SPS (Special Weather Statement) — short-fuse advisory for notable non-warning weather.

sections.description: Sections to return instead of the whole product: AFD section names, case-insensitive (e.g., "DISCUSSION", "AVIATION"), or zone codes for ZFP/HWO/SPS (e.g., "WAZ315"; a code inside a listed range such as FLZ076>078 selects that segment). Take names from the outline. Returns the product header plus every matching section verbatim, in product order, followed by the product's closing lines (forecaster credits, links). Omit for the whole product, or its outline when it is too large.

name: nws_get_office_discussion

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_products`: Office code is unknown, or no product of the requested type is filed under it: episodic types (SPS, HWO) are commonly empty, and some offices file AFD or ZFP under other location codes. `unknown_section`: A sections entry matches no section of the latest product. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

issuanceTime.description: When the product was issued (ISO 8601), e.g., "2026-05-30T10:33:00+00:00".

issuingOffice.description: Issuing office call sign (e.g., "KSEW"). Includes the K/P prefix, unlike the input office code.

notice.description: Set when the product is outlined (with a worked sections re-call) or when sections selected part of it (how many of how many sections came back).

outline.description: Sections of a product too large to inline, largest first. Present only in place of productText.

bytes.description: Size of the section text in bytes.

label.description: Area name line of a zone segment (e.g., "City of Seattle").

name.description: AFD section name (e.g., "AVIATION"), or a zone segment's zone codes as issued, ranges written NNN>MMM (e.g., "FLZ076>078, IDZ001"). Pass it, or any one zone code it covers, in sections.

productText.description: Narrative product text as issued by the forecaster: the whole product, or the product header followed by each selected section when sections was given. Absent when outline is returned.

wmoCollectiveId.description: WMO collective identifier (e.g., "FXUS66"). Identifies the product family in international message routing.

title: Nws Get Office Discussion
